label: Constraints as a graph
subgoals: Turn each setup and hold check into a difference constraint
Draw each constraint as a weighted edge
Sum the weights around a cycle to test feasibility

label: Shortest paths give a schedule
subgoals: Add a virtual source with zero-weight edges
Relax every edge until nothing changes
Read the distances as clock arrival times

label: The minimum period
subgoals: Sum the stage requirements around each cycle
Divide by the number of stages
Take the worst cycle as the period bound
